The following text was generated by one of these five AI language models:
GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Dedicating just one weekend to a basic first aid course is one of the most practical and impactful decisions you can make for yourself and those around you. The primary reason to enroll is that it thoroughly prepares you to handle common, everyday emergencies that can happen in the blink of an eye. Whether you are at home, in the office, or out in your community, accidents like choking, severe cuts, burns, or sudden cardiac events are unfortunately common. Having the knowledge to step in and provide immediate, correct assistance before professional medical help arrives can prevent injuries from worsening and can literally mean the difference between life and death for a family member, coworker, or stranger.

Beyond the practical skills you acquire, this training builds a profound sense of calm confidence that is invaluable during high-stress situations. When an emergency strikes, panic and hesitation are natural reactions, but they can paralyze you when quick action is most critical. A first aid course replaces that fear of the unknown with structured, muscle-memory responses. By practicing scenarios in a controlled environment, you learn how to assess a situation logically, take control of the environment, and deliver care systematically, which keeps both you and the injured person calmer throughout the crisis.

Finally, acquiring these life-saving skills requires a remarkably small investment of your time and money. A standard certification course typically takes only a single Saturday or Sunday to complete, meaning you can gain a lifetime of readiness without sacrificing your busy schedule. Furthermore, these classes are highly affordable, often subsidized by local community centers, schools, or employers, making them accessible to almost anyone. When you consider the immense value of being able to protect the people you care about, spending a few hours and a minimal fee on a weekend is an incredibly smart and efficient trade-off.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
